Apple has released the second public beta of iOS 27.2, which includes a revamped Health app on iPhone.

iOS 27.2 beta brings multiple updates including a brand-new Health app

iOS 27.2 will be the next release following the official launch of iOS 27 on September 14. iOS 27.1 is designed for the iPhone Duo.

The following changes come in the first public beta of iOS 27.2:

  • The redesigned Apple Health app, first unveiled at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, officially debuts in this beta.
  • Dual-camera shooting mode adds support for Group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support expands to include French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV App profile feature comes to iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' 'Up Next' has been renamed to 'Latest Episodes.' The 'Continue Playing' section has moved below 'Latest Episodes.' Podcast episode lists now also feature a background color that matches the topic color.
  • Apple Music has reduced the use of label colors that match corresponding icon colors.

iOS 27.2 is expected to officially launch at the end of this month. iPhone users looking to get an early look at the new Apple Health app can currently participate through the developer beta or public beta channels.
